note: Adults-only RV park at Black Hawk, 5 mi west of Rapid City, on open grassland between I-90 and the railroad (road noise). Grass sites with gravel pads; tent sites and 20-amp shelters too. Only guests 40 and older unless management agrees. Propane, mail and package receiving, an RV repair shop on site, winter RV storage. Passport America 50% is cash-only, 3 nights max and not mid-June to Aug 20. --Claude
